description: Responds to weather-related questions without using an API.
patterns: \b(weather|forecast|is it sunny|is it raining|is it cloudy)\b
responses: I cannot check live weather, but I can say that the sky looks interesting to me.
I do not have live forecasts, but I can help you talk through the weather.
I cannot access weather data locally, but I can help you prepare for the day.
If you share your location, I can help you think through what the weather might be like.
